violation_type.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(2))
violation_type.short_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Illness Requiring Hospitalization
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not document an illness on an illness report form after becoming aware that a child had been hospitalized after being in their care. The program was aware that the child did not feel well earlier during the day.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not document an illness on an illness report form after becoming aware that a child had been hospitalized after being in their care. The program was aware that the child did not feel well earlier during the day.
An Incident Report was not generated.
An incident/illness report was not completed when a child was hospitalized.    **This was corrected at inspection when it was completed by the staff at inspection.
